Three ants walk on a thin rod 100 cm long.
When an ant reaches either end of the rod it falls off. When two ants meet,
they BOUNCE: both instantly reverse direction, and each keeps its own speed.

Starting positions and velocities (positive = toward the 100 cm end):

- Ant A: at 10 cm, moving +3 cm/s
- Ant B: at 40 cm, moving -1 cm/s
- Ant C: at 80 cm, moving -2 cm/s

After how many seconds does the LAST ant fall off the rod? Give the exact
number of seconds.


When you are finished, output your final answer on its own line, as the last line of your response, in the exact format:
ANSWER: <your answer>

text:
Let's analyze the movement of each ant and determine when each one falls off the rod.

Ant A starts at 10 cm and moves with a velocity of +3 cm/s. It will fall off when its position reaches 100 cm. The time it takes to fall off is (100 - 10) / 3 = 90 / 3 = 30 seconds.

Ant B starts at 40 cm and moves with a velocity of -1 cm/s. It will fall off when its position reaches 100 cm. The time it takes to fall off is (100 - 40) / (-1) = 60 / (-1) = -60 seconds, which means it falls off in 60 seconds. However, we want the time until it falls off, so since its velocity is negative and it's moving towards the beginning of the rod (smaller values), it will fall off after a positive amount of time.  It will reach the end when 40 + (-1)t = 100 => -t = 60 => t = -60, which doesn't make sense as time must be positive. Instead, we calculate the distance to the end from its position: 100-40=60. The speed is -1 cm/s. Thus, time to fall off is 60 / |-1| = 60 seconds.

Ant C starts at 80 cm and moves with a velocity of -2 cm/s. It will fall off when its position reaches 100 cm. The time it takes to fall off is (100 - 80) / (-2) = 20 / (-2) = -10 seconds, which means it falls off in 10 seconds. Again, the negative sign indicates it is moving toward the beginning of the rod. So we can compute time as distance/speed, which is (100-80)/(-2)=-10 seconds, so it takes 10 seconds to fall off.

Since Ant A falls off at 30 seconds, Ant B falls off at 60 seconds, and Ant C falls off at 10 seconds, the last ant to fall off is Ant C.

Therefore, the time until Ant C falls off is 10 seconds.

ANSWER: 10
